summary.text: Dan Green is the Republican nominee for Florida's 9th Congressional District. A Navy Reserve officer who grew up in Indian River County, he served multiple tours in the Middle East and Central Asia and was appointed by President Trump in 2019 as a Deputy Assistant Secretary of Defense. His candidate survey lists his priorities as affordability, constitutional government and a strong military.

paragraphs.text: Says he grew up in Indian River County, the child of an Army veteran and a school teacher; graduated from Vero Beach High School.

Earned a bachelor's degree from American University (1998), a graduate degree from Florida State University (1999) and a Ph.D. from George Washington University (2012); describes his focus as political science and international relations.
Says he was working in the Pentagon during the September 11, 2001 attacks.

Served in the U.S. Navy Reserve, completing four tours in the Middle East and Central Asia and a civilian tour in southern Afghanistan with the U.S. Department of State; holds the rank of Commander and has been selected for promotion to Captain.
Says he was attached to two SEAL Team deployments, including in Fallujah and southern Afghanistan, and served in Baghdad and Kabul.
Appointed by President Trump in 2019 as Deputy Assistant Secretary of Defense for Strategy and Force Development at the U.S. Department of Defense.
